engineeringSkip.reason: This is a buzzword mash-up: there is real research in quantum biology (e.g. photosynthesis, avian magnetoreception), but 'embedding qubits into DNA to compute at the molecular level for genetic engineering' describes no coherent technology, physics or research programme.

factCheck.reason: It jams together the words "quantum" and "biological", but there is no known physics by which qubits can be written into DNA to run computations, so no such genetic-engineering tool exists or is being built.
